## Review: PRD 0002 — Parallel validation kernels

### Verified implementation structure

- **§1 Grid-stride conversion:** All four target kernels (`validate_claims`, `validate_transition`, `validate_effects`, `validate_outputs`) drop the `blockIdx.x != 0` guard and grid-stride their row loops. Independent fixture attribution confirms all 10 remaining guard sites belong to the 8 named serial status kernels plus the 2 new single-thread helpers — none to the targets. Already-parallel kernels are byte-unchanged.
- **§2 Deterministic minimum-index reporting:** Scratch-and-commit protocol — workers record (scan, candidate, branch) minima under a short lock with `atomicMin` on the candidate, never writing committed `status[0..=3]` (verified 0 committed-field writes in all four bodies); the single-thread commit kernel publishes `status[1]` before `status[0]` immediately after each target launch. Entrance guard keeps only the cross-launch short-circuit.
- **§3 Launch geometry:** All four launches use `LaunchConfig::for_num_elems(rows)` (per rule table / max box transition table / max wired source table) with documented zero-row fallback to `one`; `one` remains for the status kernels.
- **§4 Error surface:** `device_status()` mapping and codes untouched — the only `format!` diff lines are host-side `InvalidInput` constructors.

### Acceptance criteria

| # | Result | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | **PASS** | cuda-feature build, workspace build, `scripts/check-rust.sh` all pass. |
| 2 | **PASS** | `parallel_validation_kernels_drop_the_single_thread_guard_and_grid_stride` asserts no guard + full stride in all four bodies on a model exercising all four; passes; independently confirmed on fixture. |
| 3 | **PASS** | `parallel_validation_kernels_report_only_through_the_reduction` asserts no `status[0] =`/`status[1] =` in the four bodies and `atomicMin(status + 6, candidate)` in the helper; passes; independently confirmed. |
| 4 | **PASS** | `serial_status_kernels_keep_the_single_thread_guard` covers the 8 named kernels + 2 new helpers; passes; independently attributed. |
| 5 | **PASS** | `examples/**`, `docs/evidence/**` byte-unchanged (0 modifications); only `tests/fixtures/sir.generated.cu` changed (codegen text fixture in allowed `tests/**`, canonically regenerated). |
| 6 | **PASS** | `cargo test --locked`: 258 passed, 0 failed. Full `--features cuda` suite green: lib 16, absence 1, codegen_validation_parallelism 11, gpu_semantics 1 — the prior round's blocking failure (`gpu_semantics.rs:579/637/674` stale literals) is fixed with the `<` ordering assertions preserved. |
| 7 | **PENDING** | Recorded in README status notes per §J14.2, as the PRD permits. |
| 8 | **PENDING (local form done)** | Host-side reduction tests cover full permutations, scan precedence, branch/code pairing, and 5 simulated launch geometries; GPU run remains pending per §J14.2. |

Non-blocking notes: the `gpu_philox.rs` `rule_id`→`rule_word` repair is verified pre-existing HEAD breakage, confined to `tests/**`, disclosed in README notes. The ordered-fold single-worker exception, `effect_active` prepass, and literal re-literalization are all documented in the README status notes. Diff scope is confined to allowed files.

```json
{"assessment":"APPROVED","blockingIssues":[],"summary":"All acceptance criteria pass: the four validation kernels are grid-strided with for_num_elems launches and a deterministic scratch-and-commit atomicMin reduction preserving (scan, candidate, branch) precedence; serial kernels and protected artifacts are untouched; required emitted-source and host-side reduction tests exist and pass; cargo test --locked (258 passed) and the full --features cuda suite are green including the previously failing gpu_semantics literal assertions; hardware criteria 7-8 are properly recorded as pending per §J14.2."}
```
